name: Morehead State University
tuition_note: Kentucky resident (in-state) full-time tuition $5,201/semester = $10,402/year, from moreheadstate.edu/admissions/tuition (Fall 2026 & Spring 2027 rates effective July 1, 2026). Housing estimated at about $2,900/semester = $5,800/year (room only; meals excluded per page note). Mandatory fees (~$252/yr) not included in tuition figure since page lists tuition separately.
